domain: foundations, charities, think tanks, fiscal sponsors, grants, boards, donors, and policy-program institutions
scope: Tax-exempt and charitable organizations, private foundations, think tanks, fiscal sponsors, donor-advised and grantmaking vehicles, board and officer rosters, grants, related organizations, program-service activity, and policy-facing partnerships. The estate preserves EIN or charity-number identity, filing years, missing returns, grants, board terms, and related-party schedules.
why_new_estate: The Dialog, policy, development, professional-services, and research estates all encounter nonprofit institutions, but no existing estate owns their filings and grant chronology.

denominator_contract.unit: one legal nonprofit or charitable organization-year keyed by EIN, charity number, or company number
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Official status records, returns, determination letters, charity filings, grants, board/officer schedules, and related-organization disclosures.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Informal initiatives without a legal host; donor inference from event sponsorship; unverified nonprofit-name matches.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: required return not present for bounded year
no disclosed grant to exact entity
former officer absent in later year

source_routes.bounded_output: EIN-keyed exemption status, determination letters, Form 990-series returns, Form 990-N, Pub. 78, revocations, and bulk XML or delimited datasets.
source_routes.residual_fog: Recent returns can lag, older filings may require request, organization names vary, and return schedules must be parsed by tax year.

source_routes.authority: Charity Commission for England and Wales
source_routes.bounded_output: Registered charity numbers, trustees, filings, accounts, purposes, status, and related organizations.
source_routes.residual_fog: Other UK jurisdictions have separate regulators; trustee identity, historical filings, and linked corporate entities require resolution.

source_routes.bounded_output: State charity registration, solicitation, annual report, enforcement, and status records.
source_routes.residual_fog: Public access and identifiers vary; no national state-charity denominator exists.

source_routes.bounded_output: Company numbers, officers, PSCs, filing history, charges, insolvency, and document identifiers.
source_routes.residual_fog: Filed information may be inaccurate; document images, historical names, foreign entities, and legal-identity adjudication require further checks.

source_routes.bounded_output: Award and transaction identifiers with separate ceiling, obligation, and outlay fields.
source_routes.residual_fog: Recipient identity, award hierarchy, subaward coverage, and performance reconciliation remain estate-specific.

source_routes.bounded_output: Federal research projects, application and core project numbers, investigators, organizations, funding, opportunity numbers, dates, and linked publications.
source_routes.residual_fog: Award data does not itself establish invention, assignment, license, spinout, or later contract; organization and investigator identities require joining.

boundaries: Board service, a grant, fiscal sponsorship, or shared donor is a typed institutional fact only. It does not establish direction, agreement, control, or policy influence.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
